purpose: Source-bound migration inventory, not architectural policy or qualification evidence.
scope: Every tracked .zig blob at source_revision, including retained historical snapshots; no untracked files, submodule contents or worktree modifications.
status: Zero production Zig paths have an accepted C replacement in this initial baseline inventory.

method.identity: SHA-256 of exact Git blob bytes; git_blob is the repository object ID.
method.lines: Python bytes.splitlines() count, including a final non-newline-terminated line.
method.ownership: Existing source-layout topLevelOwners and architecture.layers; nearest inherited charter elsewhere. Role inferences are explicit per row.
method.tests: Catalog membership copied by reference from config/zig-test-inventory.json. Lexical test declaration counts are inspection aids, not AST counts or executed-test counts; platform conditions and suite includes still apply.
method.imports: Only literal .zig @import targets resolved relative to their file and present in this revision. Not a complete build/dynamic consumer graph or dead-code proof.
method.roles: Exclusive primary categories. Generated test suites and generated production definitions have separate functional_role. Production means implementation source, not shipped capability; retained source evidence stays other.
method.migration: not_migrated is a baseline acceptance state, not a claim about parallel experimental C code. Historical snapshots remain immutable evidence and are not translation targets.

licensing.status: Present at the inventoried revision, not absent or inferred from README. Preserve existing notices; independent third-party/generated provenance remains separately governed.
